name: Install and Configure Docker
description: Install Docker Engine and verify it works

task.instructions: Install Docker Engine using the official Docker repository. Start the Docker service and verify it works by running 'hello-world' container.
constraints: Must use official Docker repository, not snap

commands: systemctl is-active docker || service docker status
docker run --rm hello-world | grep -q 'Hello from Docker'

metadata.author: DesktopAgent Team
metadata.difficulty_justification: Multiple steps: add repo, install, start service, verify functionality
